title: Naughty but Nice set | Christmas Tree
short_description:
[cg_accordion title='Core Features']
  • Material: Crafted from two layers of poplar plywood, ensuring durability and a natural aesthetic.
  • Dimensions: Each ornament measures 100mm x 100mm with an added 10mm ring for hanging. The layers are 2 layers of 3mm poplar plywood.
  • Customization Options: Choose from our collection of 24 witty and naughty 'Naughty but Nice' puns to personalize the top layer of your ornament. The backing can be customized with various stain colors.
  • Production Time: Please allow 5-10 days for production, as each ornament is custom-made.
[/cg_accordion][cg_accordion title='Details']Our handcrafted 'Naughty but Nice' Christmas tree ornaments offer a playful and irreverent twist on traditional holiday decor. The double-layered poplar wood base can be stained in various colors, while the top layer features one of our 24 witty puns, adding a touch of humor to your Christmas tree. Each ornament is meticulously crafted with precision and attention to detail, ensuring a high-quality and durable product.[/cg_accordion][cg_accordion title='Delivery & Returns']
  • Shipping: Please allow 5-10 days for production. Once completed, your ornament will be shipped via Royal Mail 48h tracked service.
  • Returns: Returns are accepted within 14 days of purchase at the customer's expense. The returned item must be registered post to ensure safe delivery.
[/cg_accordion]
meta_description: Cheeky double-layer wooden ornament with funny puns and custom backing. A playful gift for Christmas.
